## Camp Polk - in-stream temperature and discharge

OWRD station ID 14076100:
<https://apps.wrd.state.or.us/apps/sw/hydro_near_real_time/display_hydro_graph.aspx?station_nbr=14076100>

```{r include=FALSE}
get_owrd_hydro <- function(
    station_nbr = "14076100",
    start_date,
    end_date,
    data_source = c(
      "MDF",                # Mean Daily Flow
      "Instantaneous_Flow", # Instantaneous Flow
      "WTEMP15",            # Instantaneous Water Temperature
      "WTEMP_MEAN",         # Mean Daily Water Temperature
      "WTEMP_MAX",          # Maximum Daily Water Temperature
      "WTEMP_MIN"           # Minimum Daily Water Temperature
    ),
    download_format = c("tsv", "html", "xls")
) {

  data_source <- match.arg(data_source)
  download_format <- match.arg(download_format)

  url <- paste0(
    "https://apps.wrd.state.or.us/apps/sw/hydro_near_real_time/display_hydro_graph.aspx?station_nbr=",
    station_nbr
  )

  # preserve cookies/session
  h <- handle(url)

  # initial GET
  resp_get <- GET(url, handle = h)
  stop_for_status(resp_get)

  page <- read_html(content(resp_get, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))
  frm <- html_form(page)[[1]]

  get_field_value <- function(form, nm) {
    x <- form$fields[[nm]]
    if (is.null(x)) return(NULL)
    x$value
  }

  body <- list(
    "__VIEWSTATE" = get_field_value(frm, "__VIEWSTATE"),
    "__VIEWSTATEGENERATOR" = get_field_value(frm, "__VIEWSTATEGENERATOR"),
    "__EVENTVALIDATION" = get_field_value(frm, "__EVENTVALIDATION"),
    "ctl00$PageData$tb_start_date" = format(as.Date(start_date), "%m/%d/%Y"),
    "ctl00$PageData$tb_end_date" = format(as.Date(end_date), "%m/%d/%Y"),
    "ctl00$PageData$ddl_data_source" = data_source,
    "ctl00$PageData$ddl_axis_type" = "LINEAR",
    "ctl00$PageData$ddl_download_format" = download_format,
    "ctl00$PageData$btn_download" = "Download"
  )

  body <- body[!vapply(body, is.null, logical(1))]

  # classic form POST
  resp_post <- POST(
    url,
    handle = h,
    body = body,
    encode = "form",
    add_headers(
      Referer = url,
      Origin = "https://apps.wrd.state.or.us"
    )
  )

  stop_for_status(resp_post)

  ctype <- headers(resp_post)[["content-type"]] %||% ""
  raw <- content(resp_post, as = "raw")
  txt <- content(resp_post, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")

  # TSV is usually the easiest / most reliable
  if (download_format == "tsv" || str_detect(ctype, "tab|plain|octet-stream")) {
    return(
      read_tsv(I(txt), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
        clean_names()
    )
  }

  if (download_format == "html" || str_detect(ctype, "html")) {
    tabs <- read_html(txt) |> html_table(fill = TRUE)
    if (length(tabs) == 0) {
      cat(substr(txt, 1, 1000))
      stop("No HTML table returned; try download_format = 'tsv'.")
    }
    return(tabs[[1]] |> clean_names())
  }

  if (download_format == "xls" || str_detect(ctype, "excel|spreadsheet|ms-excel")) {
    tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".xls")
    writeBin(raw, tmp)
    return(readxl::read_excel(tmp) |> clean_names())
  }

  cat(substr(txt, 1, 1000))
  stop("Unrecognized response type.")
}

`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) y else x

```

```{r}
# instantaneous flow
flow_daily_raw <- get_owrd_hydro(
  station_nbr = "14076100",
  start_date = Sys.Date()-5,
  end_date = Sys.Date()-1,
  data_source = "Instantaneous_Flow",
  download_format = "tsv"
)

# instantaneous water temperature
temp_daily_raw <- get_owrd_hydro(
  station_nbr = "14076100",
  start_date = Sys.Date()-5,
  end_date = Sys.Date()-1,
  data_source = "WTEMP15",
  download_format = "tsv"
) 

temperature <- temp_daily_raw |> 
  rename(date = record_date, 
         temp_c = instantaneous_water_temp_c) |> 
  mutate(date = mdy_hm(date),
         download_date = mdy_hm(download_date)) |> 
  mutate(station_name = "Camp Polk (OWRD)") |> 
  glimpse()

flow <- flow_daily_raw |> 
  rename(date = record_date, 
         flow_cfs = instananteous_flow_cfs) |> 
  mutate(date = mdy_hm(date)) |> 
  mutate(station_name = "Camp Polk (OWRD)") |> 
  glimpse()

```

```{r}
ggplot(data = temperature, 
       aes(x = date, y = temp_c)) + 
  geom_line() +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(data = flow, 
       aes(x = date, y = flow_cfs)) + 
  geom_line() +
  theme_minimal()

```

## Air Temperature

<https://weather-gov.github.io/api/gridpoints#>:\~:text=What's%20a%20gridpoint%3F,of%20these%202.5km%20squares

Data options:

-   temperature: Air temperature

-   dewpoint: Dewpoint temperature

-   maxTemperature: High temperature

-   minTemperature: Low temperature

-   relativeHumidity: Relative humidity

-   apparentTemperature: Apparent temperature (heat index or wind chill)

-   heatIndex: Heat index. This is the apparentTemperature data with
    values filtered out that are below the threshold of the heat index
    calculation.

-   windChill: Wind chill. This is the apparentTemperature data with
    values filtered out that are above the threshold of the wind chill
    calculation.

-   skyCover: Percentage of sky with cloud cover

-   windDirection: Direction of prevailing wind

-   windSpeed: Maximum prevailing wind speed

-   windGust: Maximum wind gust

RM 8.5 data logger location: 44.390278, -121.406792

```{r}
# find the grid by running this: 
link <- "https://api.weather.gov/points/44.390278,-121.406792"
grid <- request(link) |>
  req_perform() |>
  resp_body_json()
grid$properties$forecastGridData

# to get forecast: 
link_met <- "https://api.weather.gov/gridpoints/PDT/35,57"

weather_forecast <- request(link_met) |>
  req_perform() |>
  resp_body_json()

air_temp <- weather_forecast$properties$temperature$values |>
    map_dfr(~ tibble(
    validTime = .x$validTime,
    air_temperature_c = .x$value
  )) |>
  mutate(
    datetime = ymd_hms(str_extract(validTime, "^[^/]+")),
    duration = str_extract(validTime, "(?<=/)PT\\d+H")
  ) |>
  select(datetime, air_temperature_c, duration)

max_air_temp <- weather_forecast$properties$maxTemperature$values |> 
  map_dfr(~ tibble(
    validTime = .x$validTime,
    max_air_temp_c = .x$value
  )) |>
  mutate(
    datetime = ymd_hms(str_extract(validTime, "^[^/]+")),
    duration = str_extract(validTime, "(?<=/)PT\\d+H")
  ) |>
  select(datetime, max_air_temp_c, duration)

min_air_temp <- weather_forecast$properties$minTemperature$values |> 
  map_dfr(~ tibble(
    validTime = .x$validTime,
    min_air_temp_c = .x$value
  )) |>
  mutate(
    datetime = ymd_hms(str_extract(validTime, "^[^/]+")),
    duration = str_extract(validTime, "(?<=/)PT\\d+H")
  ) |>
  select(datetime, min_air_temp_c, duration)

```

```{r}

ggplot(air_temp, aes(x = datetime, y = air_temperature_c)) + 
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(data = min_air_temp, aes(x = datetime, y = min_air_temp_c, color = "min")) + 
  geom_point(data = max_air_temp, aes(x = datetime, y = max_air_temp_c, color = "max")) + 
  theme_minimal()

```
## Past Weather Forecasts

```{r}
library(aws.s3)

bucket <- "noaa-ndfd-pds"

objects <- get_bucket(
  bucket,
  region = "us-east-1",
  anonymous = TRUE
)

bucket_df <- aws.s3::get_bucket_df(
  "noaa-ndfd-pds",
  region = "us-east-1",
  anonymous = TRUE
)

download_ndfd_file <- function(key, destfile) {
  url <- paste0("https://noaa-ndfd-pds.s3.amazonaws.com/", key)
  download.file(url, destfile, mode = "wb")
  destfile
}

download_ndfd_file(
  key = "NDFDelem_fullres_202206.xls",
  destfile = "NDFDelem_fullres_202206.xls"
)



url <- "https://noaa-ndfd-pds.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/ST.expr/DF.gr2/DC.ndfd/AR.conus/VP.004-007/ds.temp.bin"
httr2::request(url) |>
  httr2::req_method("HEAD") |>
  httr2::req_perform()

download.file(url, "ds.temp.bin", mode = "wb")
```
